Hiring foreign workers through the Temporary Foreign Worker Program (TFWP) can help Canadian employers fill critical labour shortages, but the process begins with one crucial step: securing a positive Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA). A positive LMIA Requirements confirms that no Canadian citizen or permanent resident is available to do the job, and that hiring a temporary foreign worker will not negatively impact the Canadian labour market.
